product_overview: Skyhook is a lightweight FastAPI-based file server that provides an HTML file browser, secure file download and upload capabilities, and a simple health check endpoint. It supports optional basic authentication and path-sanitized access to help users browse and manage files in a served directory.
core_goals: Provide a browser-based view of the served filesystem
Allow users to download files directly by path
Enable multipart file uploads into a target directory
Protect file operations with path sanitization and optional basic authentication
Expose a minimal health endpoint for service monitoring

features.name: File Browser UI
features.description: Allows users to view the root directory and navigate into subdirectories through HTML pages.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 HTML listing of the root directory -> GET /browse/documents -> Receive 200 HTML listing of the documents directory
GET /browse/../../etc/passwd -> Receive 403 blocked path traversal response
GET /browse/nonexistent-directory -> Receive 404 if the requested directory cannot be resolved

features.name: File Download API
features.description: Allows users to download a file from the served directory by specifying its path.
user_flows: GET /download/reports/summary.pdf -> Receive 200 FileResponse with the file contents
GET /download/reports/ -> Receive 400 response indicating the path is not a file
GET /download/../../secret.txt -> Receive 403 response indicating path traversal is blocked
GET /download/missing.txt -> Receive 404 response indicating the file was not found

features.name: File Upload API
features.description: Allows users to upload one or more files to a directory using multipart form data.
user_flows: POST /upload with multipart form-data including files and optional path=uploads -> Receive 200 UploadResult confirming saved files
POST /upload with multipart form-data and path=../../etc -> Receive 403 response indicating path traversal is blocked
POST /upload with multipart form-data and path=/invalid/location -> Receive 400 response indicating the upload directory is invalid
POST /upload with empty or malformed multipart payload -> Receive 400 response for invalid upload request

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: Provides a simple endpoint for checking service availability and version information.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with status and version fields
GET /health after service startup failure -> Receive non-200 error response or unavailable connection
